definition: Bounded PHB2014 Linguist source-and-authentic-legacy-ASI API proof: fixed INT+1 default cap20 and exactly3 canonical PHB18 languages. Cipher remains manual. Not full Linguist automation, all-language support, browser acceptance, server persistence or publication.
boundaries: Exactly18 reviewed PHB language kinds,8standard/8exotic/2secret. Other sources and scripts are not silently selectable; unsupported does not mean RAW forbidden.
Primordial is one kind. Its four dialects and bounded formatting aliases never grant extra slots or imported consent. Persisted intent requires exact canonical references.
Exotic/secret permission equals the selected restricted canonical set. Global source exceptions, existing text and catalog enablement do not authorize it.

One explicit independently versioned owned confirmation covers fixed INT and exactly3 languages. INT20/22 yields+0 without suppressing valid languages; language-only suspension does not suppress legal INT.
Manual languages, including an empty string, override presentation only. No manual values, proficiency maps, HP, consumed resources, inventory or other confirmation domains are rewritten.
Source hashes bind the source audit; runtime mechanical identity checks do not cryptographically authenticate imported publisher prose.

Cipher creation, teaching, DC adjudication, decoding and magical reading remain manual. The source refers to the author INT score plus PB, not the modifier; no cipher entities/actions/resources are created.

The actual old78e1 client preserves opaque intent but may retain stale consent after parent clear/reselect. Safe editing compatibility is false; withdraw and reconfirm in the new client after old-client edits.
Native single-card/collection and linked native payload are API checks only. Thin legacy Owlbear language/tool arrays stay empty; browser storage/cloud delivery/deployment are separate gates.

Historical Aarakocra one-choice witness is not migrated or reclassified. Generic language derivation has no new PHB identity/DM/owner contract; no whole-inventory denominator or global schema/server change is claimed.

publicReference.summary: Standard or campaign-common selection differs from DM-authorized exotic/secret selection; Primordial has four dialects but is one language family.
